title: PageInfoSection
description: The sections of a record's page info, in display order. One id names both the chrome's page-info row and card (data-page-info-row / data-page-info-card) and the matching section of the governing EPR page, so every card's link ends at /epr/<recordId>#<section>. `yours` appears only for a signed-in viewer; `delivery` and `permissions` only when there is a content object to deliver and frame. Source of truth: this schema (vocabulary only, Category C) — it stores nothing.

_source.rationale: Section ids are written by both the chrome and the EPR page; one vocabulary keeps the two from drifting
